message.content:
Yes, you can report a noise complaint to the City of Atlanta’s local council.  
In Atlanta, noise complaints are generally handled by the **City of Atlanta Police Department** or the **Department of Public Safety**.  

**How to file a complaint**

| Method | Details |
|--------|---------|
| **Phone** | Call the City of Atlanta Noise Complaint Hotline at **(404) 656‑4000**. |
| **Online** | Use the City of Atlanta’s official website: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/Noise> to submit a noise complaint form. |
| **In‑person** | Visit the nearest police precinct or the City Hall’s public safety office. |

When filing, be prepared to provide:
- Your name and contact information (optional but helpful)
- The address or location of the noise source
- A description of the noise (time, duration, type)
- Any evidence (audio recordings, photos)

The city will investigate and take appropriate action, which may include issuing warnings or fines depending on the severity and frequency of the noise violation.
